description: This file defines a service handler class 'SaleLoanToExternalAssetOwnerHandler' responsible for processing commands related to selling a loan to an external asset owner within the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and relies on an external service to perform the sale operation.

classes.name: SaleLoanToExternalAssetOwnerHandler
classes.description: A service component that handles commands to sale loans to external asset owners, annotated for dependency injection and command processing.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to initiate a sale of a loan by calling the write service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the incoming command and invokes the external asset owner write service to perform the sale.
